text: Most money problems come from a few habits. Remember: charge once, check the invoice, and refund before you void.
One: clicking charge again because the screen is slow. Wait for the note: Charged the card on file.
Two: retrying a declined card. Check the total and what's paid first, then ask for another card.
Three: charging a member full price. Look for covered and the member discount, or use Reprice.
Four: charging the card when the family has credit or a gift card. Apply those first.
In the field, you'll usually take a card with Tap to Pay on the Stripe reader.
This demo has no reader connected, so we'll use Card over phone. It works the same way.
Five: saving a card without asking. Only keep the card if the owner agrees.
Six: checks left in the car. Deposit cash and checks the same day.
Seven: voiding a paid bill. Scout stops you. Refund the card payment first.
Eight: a plain refund when items came back. Use Return items, so stock and the chart are right, and the money goes back card first, then credit.
Remember: charge once, check the invoice, and refund before you void.
